method: PUCT on paper, c=1.2, 3 rounds. Probes: a 52 s timing run (48 copies x 180 s, seed 1 -> ~4 ms per copy-second, so ~180 copies fit in 10 min), a 2 s bootstrap on the saved friction pool (B=99, p 0.01), a load of the per-copy speed-limit files (196 human-only copies exist), two web searches (friction thresholds; Davies' test). Final N: replication 2, search-corrected knee 2, speed-limit knee 1 (merged into the knee tool), the rest 0-1.
